headline: Feliz's 11th-inning homer walks off Dodgers
recap: Pedro Feliz hit a three-run home run with one out in the bottom of the 11th inning off Jason Johnson, scoring Shane Victorino and Chris Coste, to give the Phillies a 5-2 walk-off win over the Los Angeles Dodgers at Citizens Bank Park.

Phillies starter Joe Blanton allowed one earned run on six hits over six innings with four strikeouts and three walks. Dodgers starter Hiroki Kuroda matched him with six innings of his own, also charged with one earned run, striking out five and walking two.

Los Angeles took a 1-0 lead in the first on James Loney's RBI single, and the Phillies tied it in the fifth on Chase Utley's single. The Dodgers went back ahead 2-1 in the seventh on Jeff Kent's RBI single off Ryan Madson, but Feliz tied it again in the ninth with a two-out single off closer Jonathan Broxton, who was charged with a blown save. Chad Durbin worked two scoreless innings and picked up the win when Feliz connected in the 11th.
